original_ai_output.title_zh: 伊巴丹大学教授呼吁以非军事手段应对匪盗与叛乱
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚伊巴丹大学心理学教授阿德雷米·阿拉拉佩在心理学系成立50周年活动上，呼吁联邦政府采用非动能安全手段应对匪盗、叛乱和社区冲突。他主张将行为与心理洞察纳入公共政策，并建议设立国家行为洞察部门。该报道为单一来源。

location.site: 伊巴丹大学心理学圆形厅

key_facts.fact: 伊巴丹大学心理学教授阿拉拉佩呼吁联邦政府采用非动能安全手段应对匪盗、叛乱和社区冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A professor of Psychology at the University of Ibadan, Aderemi Alarape, has urged the Federal Government to employ non-kinetic security approaches to counter the challenges of banditry, insurgency, and communal strife.

key_facts.fact: 该建议是在伊巴丹大学心理学系成立50周年活动上提出的
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Alarape gave the advice during the 50th anniversary of the Department of Psychology of the university, held at the Psychology Rotunda, UI, on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: 他建议政府设立国家行为洞察部门，将行为与心理洞察纳入公共政策
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: government must establish a National Behavioural Insights Unit to ensure that policies (from taxation to health campaigns) are designed with a deep understanding of human behaviour and decision-making.

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
事件时间与活动具体日期存在差异，活动日期尚未确认
